sources.section: FR-016, FR-017, SC-006; acceptance and executor gates
Small prerequisite — reference-based independent review; ordered delivery stage 1
Small reference-based prerequisite and admission; unchanged shipped runtime and executable checks
Current specification renewal — 2026-10-19; planning authority only

assumptions: Instruction-managed bootstrap preparation only, NOT a CLI-dispatched app task or approved runtime mutation. Final owner approval must explicitly select this execution mode and exact precursor scope before implementation.

One implementer writer; named reference/custody seams and REQUIRED checks are explicit, routine helper implementation choices remain open. Fresh independent full-original-range review and current acceptance precede source-local app runtime admission.

Narrow CLI/helper/test/doc bootstrap edits use normal Pi tools under exact approved instruction-managed ownership, not CLI dispatch or a size exception. No broad refactor or host/protocol edit. Existing read_file32768-byte/write-schema32768-character and task-loader2_000_000-byte limits stay unchanged; no universal file-size rule or new guard. Machine JSON may exceed32KB.

Existing read_file permissions, admitted source/approval hashes, SQLite custody and SDK protocol are reused. No immutable historical wheel is assumed. Accepted runtime stays unchanged throughout the app build.
execution_intent.provenance: Owner separately selected implementation Sol/medium, clarified 'use 6.1 sol medium', retained in spec.md and current specification-approval.md. Parent task brief preserves exact target openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol:medium independently of planning selection. Later owner direction: references rather than copying; 'Yes, make sure the changes are small and continue. You blocked yourself with a tiny issue that was really easy to fix.' This authorizes preparation, not runtime edits or bootstrap-mode acceptance.
execution_intent.decomposition_rationale: One independently necessary precursor outcome: reference-delivered independent review, permanent actual-helper tests, smallest composed existing runtime review, aligned operating docs and focused checkpoint. Keep code/tests/docs/evidence together; no prototype or administrative task chain. Sol/medium receives exact invariants and gates without routine microtasks. No model superiority or effort-benefit claim.

compatible_bindings.assessment: Compatible intended implementation/repair target for this bounded explicit contract; actual fresh usable tools/resources/auth/effort and separate reviewer readiness remain required. Not execution authority.
compatible_bindings.provenance: Exact owner implementation selection, recorded in spec.md and specification-approval.md and unchanged parent task brief; existing runtime operating guide supports codex-final-payload observer version 1 only for this binding.

tasks.outcome: Separately prepare and accept the smallest reference-delivered independent-review runtime adjustment before any app execution; never mutate an executing app runtime or claim this is a CLI-dispatched bootstrap.

required.criterion: Complete pinned source/approval reference inventory replaces only redundant document bodies; original authoritative contract, full binary original-base-to-current-head patch, REQUIRED items, states, evidence, checkpoints, findings and dynamic correction contracts remain available. Remove a per-task receipt contract copy only when exact canonical identity to its authoritative original task proves equivalence; unequal/dynamic contracts remain intact. Final bundle stays within unchanged 120000-byte guard and SDK 262144-byte protocol.

args.mode: instruction-managed unittest; NOT registered runtime capability; proposed permanent class

required.pass_condition: Positive test collection, no skip/error/failure; compare complete admitted reference set and raw binary patch/evidence before/after; equal-contract receipts use canonical identity, unequal/dynamic contracts survive. Measure actual final serialized bundle bytes and reject genuine oversize without truncation or increased limits.
required.expected_evidence: Nonempty unittest output with count/exit and assertions for exact inventory, task-identity equivalence, full-range patch/evidence preservation, actual payload byte measurement and oversize rejection, bound to tested precursor revision/environment.

required.criterion: Every required reference is actually read through existing authorized read_file. Validate safe file identity, UTF-8 decoding and immutable raw pinned hash on the SAME bytes returned. Before record_review/finding resolution/acceptance, audit minimal read receipts against the originating independent review host/turn, process operation and exact bundle/range/reference identity. No model-prose read claim, arbitrary path expansion, separate hash-then-reread race, content transcript ledger or previous/wrong-host coverage.

args.mode: instruction-managed unittest; NOT registered runtime capability; proposed permanent class

required.pass_condition: Actual production read/bundle/coverage helpers exercised; positive exact delivery succeeds; missing, changed, deleted, unsafe/symlink, unrelated unauthorized, unread, wrong-hash, wrong-host/turn/range or undelivered reads reject before acceptance side effects. Coverage joins real process/SDK turn settlement and returned-byte hash, not just file-open intent. Original continuation may reuse proof only with exact applicable independent lineage/bundle and current validated delivered receipts.
required.expected_evidence: Nonempty named positive/negative unittest assertions and exit/count; show actual returned-byte SHA matching pinned ref and receipt, complete required coverage and zero acceptance/finding-resolution effects for rejected coverage. Helper fixtures alone are not composed SDK proof; V4 supplies that boundary.

required.criterion: Smallest composed shipped-runtime independent-review exercise proves actual reference delivery and coverage enforcement BEFORE acceptance while preserving fresh read-only independent role, original full-range patch, real REQUIRED/checkpoint/correction/rereview evidence, custody and original gates. Extend the existing isolated review/correction test, not a new framework or fake production receipt.

required_external_inputs: COHERENCE_TEST_CGROUP_PARENT: explicitly approved existing delegated parent
args.mode: instruction-managed existing local unittest, NOT CLI check dispatch; live run separately gated

required.pass_condition: Actual isolated CLI/SDK/Gateway review obtains every pinned ref and retains same-byte read receipts tied to the review host/turn/process before passing review. Original range, finding/correction/checkpoint chain and current acceptance survive. Against real settled proof, remove or mismatch coverage and assert acceptance/recording rejects, then restore original proof for a valid acceptance audit. Nonempty process/cgroup and SDK proof, positive collection/no skips, exact Sol/medium requests; no stale identities/catalogs/receipts or mock-only positive claim.
required.expected_evidence: Existing test output plus added reference coverage assertions, isolated run/base/head/review-host/turn/read-process/hash correlations, denied incomplete/wrong-review acceptance assertions and actual final acceptance/custody receipts. Preserve all failed-attempt diagnostics; test-only standing approval provenance never claims human production approval.

required.criterion: Update only affected runtime operating/schema descriptions to match actual pinned-reference and delivered-read coverage behavior. Existing protocol, authority scopes/effects, external-catalog authenticity, REQUIRED/gates, original patch, custody, signing/hooks and runner-only app checkpoint semantics remain unchanged. No new schema field, generic artifact platform, registry/dependency expansion or runtime redesign.

args.mode: instruction-managed manual source/diff inspection; NOT registered runtime capability
args.baseline: exact approved precursor implementation baseline captured before mutation

required.pass_condition: Diff check exits zero; explicit symbol-to-doc comparison matches observed behavior and error/limit semantics. Actual diff touches only seven owned paths, narrow wiring in cli.py, focused helper/tests/docs; no app/lock/config/host/schema/skill changes or runtime constant increases.
required.expected_evidence: Nonempty symbol/doc comparison notes, exact owned diff/stat, diff-check output/exit and explicit confirmation that 120000/262144 and authority/custody/approval semantics remain unchanged. Any new required path or material scope change returns to producing review/current approval, not opportunistic implementation expansion.

required.criterion: Checkpoint this coherent precursor with explicit owned paths after V1, V2, V4, V5 verification, then obtain fresh separate independent full-original-range implementation review and current acceptance before app baseline admission. This bootstrap is instruction-managed, not dispatched by CLI and never marked as an app task completed. Accepted adjusted source-local runtime is immutable during the later app run; preserve all SC-001–006 and same-build retrospective/live dogfooding without demonstration replacement.

args.mode: instruction-managed focused writer checkpoint plus separate fresh independent review; NOT registered runtime capability
args.range: approved precursor implementation baseline through exact final precursor head including any focused corrections
args.reviewer_history: fresh; no implementer history; full source/task/patch/REQUIRED evidence
args.release: parent inspects exact checkpoint, independent findings/dispositions, current acceptance and refreshed runtime identities before app start

required.pass_condition: V1, V2, V4, V5 have current nonempty required evidence. Writer validates/inspects actual diff, stages/commits only seven owned paths preserving unrelated work/hooks/signing/identity. Separate fresh reviewer accepts exact current full range with no unresolved findings and verifies original REQUIRED/gates; corrections require authorized focused verified checkpoints and affected rereview. Parent explicitly admits this accepted revision as later app runtime baseline; no runtime already executing from it during edits. Missing proof/authority blocks app reliance.
required.expected_evidence: Implementation baseline/result SHAs and path-limited commit/tree/diff, all V1, V2, V4, V5 evidence refs and current applicability, separate reviewer identity/range/findings/dispositions/current acceptance, refreshed source/config/registry/resource identities and parent baseline admission. This task file and static checks provide none of that implementation evidence yet.

gates.criterion: UNRESOLVED: independent overall planning review and genuine current-content owner approval must explicitly authorize this separate instruction-managed bootstrap execution mode, seven-path runtime scope and narrow CLI/helper/test/operating-doc edits. App specification renewal alone grants no runtime mutation authority.
gates.scope: Exact current prerequisite-tasks.md/json and supporting Standard source/plan identities; proposed bootstrap only, before app CLI run. No source amendment, TinySpec/legacy relabel, app implementation, installs or existing live-runtime mutation.
gates.expected_evidence: Actual parent owner-tool answer bound to reviewed current contents and exact bootstrap mode/owned paths, independently reviewed scope and execution release; denial/cancellation/drift blocks. No worker-authored external authority catalog or invented approval_ref.

gates.criterion: Before implementation/tests, recheck sole writer/no active or unknown runtime using mutable source, current baseline/Git hooks/signing, actual local Python dependencies and exact profile/resources. Before V4 additionally verify scoped local live/model/test/cgroup/read-only auth/catalog/scratch authority and genuine standing test-only approvals. No install/auth/config workaround or uninspected retry.
gates.scope: Bootstrap writer and named unittest commands only; existing isolated tests may use real runtime custody in a separate test-owned project. No app run dispatch, paid service, historical wheel adoption or old run/receipt/catalog reuse.
gates.expected_evidence: Current writer/resource/baseline admission; actual interpreter/import readiness; explicit approved scratch and existing delegated containment identity with verified readiness; genuine current auth/catalog/profile/tool availability and test-only scope. Missing capabilities mean NOT VERIFIED, never skip-to-pass.
